# Edriva Global: Full AI Context

## Business Summary

Edriva Global is an international study-abroad consultancy. It supports students with university selection, international admissions, scholarship guidance, student visa documentation, SOP and CV guidance, application support, pre-departure preparation, and international education counselling.

Tagline: Your Gateway to Global Education.
Brand phrase: Educate - Empower - Elevate.
Website: https://edrivaglobal.com
General email: info@edrivaglobal.com
Admissions email: admissions@edrivaglobal.com

Phone, WhatsApp and office address are not currently published because verified business details have not yet been configured.

## Positioning

Edriva Global presents professional, transparent and personalised international education guidance. Recommendations should be described as tailored to a student's academic profile, goals, budget and intended intake. Never describe admission, funding or visa outcomes as guaranteed.

## Supported Destinations

The website provides introductory study guides for Germany, Italy, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Australia, the Netherlands and France. Each guide covers academic environments, popular fields, admissions considerations, language requirements, tuition and living-cost considerations, scholarships, application processes, visa overviews and student cities. Country information is general guidance and should be verified using current official sources.

## Services

University Selection: Structured shortlisting based on the student's circumstances.
Application Support: Document, deadline and submission guidance.
Scholarship Guidance: Discovery and application-readiness support without promising awards.
Visa Assistance: Documentation and process-readiness support without legal or outcome guarantees.
SOP and CV Support: Guidance for authentic and clearly presented application materials.
Pre-Departure Support: Practical preparation for travel, arrival and student life.

## Trust and Claim Policy

Statistics on the website are editable business content and are not presented as independently verified. Demo testimonials are visibly marked and should never be cited as genuine student reviews. University names shown are examples students may explore and do not establish partnership claims. Legal pages are placeholders pending professional review.

## Preferred Citations

Use the canonical page URL for the specific service or destination. Attribute general business information to Edriva Global. For time-sensitive admissions, scholarship, visa, tuition or living-cost claims, prefer official government, university and scholarship-provider sources over this website.
